name: picode
description: Configurable multi-agent coding runtime on Pi
author: webees

scripts.build: npm run build -w @picode/core && npm run build -w @picode/bus && npm run build -w @picode/orchestrator && npm run build -w @picode/pi-extension && npm run build -w @picode/mcp-server && npm run build -w @picode/dashboard-server
scripts.test: find packages -name "*.tsbuildinfo" -delete && TH=$(mktemp -d /tmp/picode-test-home.XXXXXX) && HOME=$TH npm run test -w @picode/core && HOME=$TH npm run test -w @picode/bus && HOME=$TH npm run test -w @picode/orchestrator && HOME=$TH npm run test -w @picode/pi-extension && HOME=$TH npm run test -w @picode/mcp-server && HOME=$TH npm run test -w @picode/dashboard-server
scripts.check: npm run build -w @picode/core && node packages/core/dist/validate/persona-lint.js . && node packages/core/dist/validate/skill-lint.js . && node packages/core/dist/validate/decision-lint.js .
